sources.snippet: VibeVoice-Realtime is a lightweight real‑time text-to-speech model supporting streaming text input and robust long-form speech generation. It can be used to build real-time TTS services, narrate live data streams, and let different LLMs start speaking from their very first tokens (plug in your preferred model) long before a full answer is generated. sources.snippet: Overview VibeVoice-Realtime-.5B is a lightweight, open-source text-to-speech model built by microsoft that generates speech from streaming text input with approximately 300 ms first audible latency.
